text.p: Investment bank Schroders said in a report it had upgraded its rating for Indonesia's pharmaceutical firm PT Kalbe Farma to "outperform" on the stock market from "underperform" previously.
It said its share price had underperformed the market and was trading in early September at an historic low of 12.2 times 1996 and 10.2 times 1997 prospective earnings.
It said the stock was a bargain compared to rival PT Darya Varia and those of PT Tempo Scan Pacific.
"We expect a compound earnings rate of 18.6 percent for earnings per share from 1996 to 1998, with an accelerating growth rate," Schroders said in its latest research report.

It said Kalbe had significantly underperformed the market because of the firm's lack of focus on its core business, causing a build-up of inventories and negative growth from non-core businesses such as packaging and consumer products.
Schroders said the company was restructuring its non-core business and refocusing on its core business, for which production capacity would double.
